notes: Window chrome is consolidated to one always-visible ⠿ handle per operational unit; the previous five-icon hover cluster is removed.
Clicking the handle opens a persistent labelled menu: Réduire, Détacher/Raccrocher, Agrandir/Taille normale, Masquer. The menu stays open until an action, outside click or Escape.
Dragging the handle while Free Windows is active detaches and moves the original operational unit; business DOM is never cloned.
Réduire now creates one compact visible restore bar in the native location. Masquer alone removes the unit completely and WINDOW DECK recalls it.
Graphique + Lecture technique/Lecture Métaux remains one original #analyste unit; Target Top, Market Flow, Market Snapshot and Math Core remain independent operational units.
The twelve operational units, dual Crypto/Métaux domain contract, global versioning and validated Metal Base 39.1 theme are preserved.
No market fetch, WebSocket, Atlas, NØX, Aerith, Bridge or Ollama behavior is added by the window layer.
